parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: ManagerAccount
parameters.description:
The name of the manager account that has the rds_superuser permission.

>  You can create an account on the Account Management page of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL console or by calling the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation.

parameters.name: ManagerAccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the database account.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb init-vector-database --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb InitVectorDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --ManagerAccount testaccount --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
